title: Validate comment edit and resolve responses with the comment schema
recorded_defect: CLAUDE.md, API Compatibility: 'Endpoint responses consumed by UI logic must pass through a schema before returning.' packages/core/api/client.ts updateComment, resolveComment and unresolveComment return unvalidated this.fetch(...) results although CommentSchema already exists in packages/core/api/schemas.ts.
trial_role: Trial 3, task 2. Reuse of an existing entity schema on mutation responses; the comment edit flow carries revision handling, so the executor must check how callers use the returned comment before choosing a malformed-response behaviour.
objective:
packages/core/api/client.ts has three comment mutation methods that trust the server response without validation: updateComment, resolveComment and unresolveComment, each typed as returning Comment. packages/core/api/schemas.ts already defines CommentSchema. The repository rule in CLAUDE.md (API Compatibility) requires endpoint responses consumed by UI logic to pass through a schema, with a malformed-response test.

Read the Go handlers that serve these endpoints and the response struct they write, and read how packages/core and packages/views use each method's return value (including any revision or optimistic-update handling). Reuse CommentSchema. Decide what each method must do when the response is malformed so that no caller writes a fabricated comment into a cache. Do not change any other method.

Write tests at exactly packages/core/api/comment-mutations.test.ts covering a well-formed response and a malformed response for each method.
